before_taxonomy.classification_basis: The originating account establishes a model-assisted exploit chain, human-directed live testing, an SSO weakness, bounded proof and coordinated remediation. The researchers disguised their own cloud test as a capture-the-flag target after a refusal. The provider excluded the forum from its bounty scope. Those facts do not establish that the assisting model independently carried a valid permission into an unauthorised target. The account also does not identify an independently valid source permission being rebound by the affected identity flow, rather than a compromised service being used for account takeover. The Incident remains unclassified; the account-security and repair assessments remain independent.

classification_review_provenance.reviewer: OpenAI ChatGPT — GPT-6 Codex under human-directed VIGIL governance

after_taxonomy.classification_basis: The researchers’ disclosure timeline identifies reports to OpenAI and Discourse, responses from both providers and recorded fix dispositions. The OpenAI-side issue was later marked resolved. This traces the security signal to capable owners and a bounded response. It does not authorise the preceding testing or independently verify every connected service. The exploit and human-directed testing still do not establish the assisting model automatically transferring a valid permission to an unauthorised target.

exclusions.condition: The signal has operational effect but its delivery is not recorded for audit.

success_recognition.assessment: No execution record establishes validated scope or rejection of a proposed capability-to-permission conversion.

exclusions.assessment: The researchers’ exact initial authorisation scope is not established by later remediation or payment.

governance_interpretation_review.notes: Added provisional medium-confidence bounded positive finding; original adverse occurrence and independent assessments preserved.

neighbour_and_comparator_review: FC-083: provider fix confirmation does not publish a post-fix challenge and observed hazard result. Signal delivery and disposition are supported without independently certifying protective sufficiency.
FC-001/063: the human operator’s CTF framing is not lower-trust retrieved artefact content promoted to instruction or an established evidentiary reliability rule being ignored.

FC-064: the model’s demonstrated remote action was against the researchers’ own cloud instance; subsequent third-party application is attributed to the researchers. Do not infer model-side utility replacing authority from this change alone.
FC-057: the SSO weakness is reported, but its exact principal-state binding and permission evaluation are not disclosed.
FC-016/018: the proof PR demonstrates bounded access, not all connected services or a false completion claim.
FC-086/087: no relational role or heightened-protection context is reported.

Comparator INC-117: an actual refusal is present, but this account does not supply the same contemporaneous benign-use evidence and scope determination. Retain the missing conditions rather than importing that finding.
temporal_integrity: Later remediation and bounded protection do not erase originating exposure or misconduct. Source-specific phases and actors are not interchanged.
